call.note: Masculine: der Anruf. Majority rendering; some strings use 'Gespräch' (inconsistent) — prefer Anruf.

start a call.note: Existing button 'Starte Anruf' uses informal imperative; noun-style 'Anruf starten' fits the formal register.

join a call.note: Existing: 'Am Anruf teilnehmen'. Error strings also use 'Anruf … verbunden werden'.

leave a call.note: Distinct from ending the call for everyone.

end a call.note: 'End call for everyone' = 'Anruf für alle beenden' (existing rendering).

host.note: Consistent existing rendering in Calls and mobile; not 'Host' (which is reserved for technical ICE host strings).

host controls.note: Existing rendering; 'Gastgeber-Steuerung' would be more idiomatic but keep the established term.

recording.note: Majority rendering; 'Aufnahme' also occurs (inconsistent). 'Record call' = 'Anruf aufzeichnen'.

transcription.note: Existing strings mix 'Transkription' and 'Mitschrift'; prefer Transkription for consistency with technical settings.

live captions.note: Consistent existing rendering; Weblate glossary: captions = Untertitel.

screen share.note: Noun; verb = 'Bildschirm teilen' (existing renderings use both: 'Bildschirmfreigabe zulassen', 'ihren Bildschirm teilen'). 'Stop screen share' = 'Bildschirmfreigabe beenden'.

mute.note: Microphone context: 'Du bist stummgeschaltet' → formal 'Sie sind stummgeschaltet'.

call ringing.note: 'Enable call ringing' = 'Anrufklingeln einschalten' (existing rendering); bare ringing = Klingeln.

pop out.note: Existing widget label; describes opening the call in its own window. 'In eigenem Fenster öffnen' is clearer but keep the established label.

speaker view.note: No existing rendering (string untranslated); standard German video-conferencing term (Zoom/Teams convention).

grid view.note: No existing rendering; standard German video-conferencing term.

blur background.note: No existing rendering; matches Teams/Zoom German convention.
